question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
SELECT 
    b.bowler AS bowler_id,
    p.player_name AS bowler_name,
    ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ex.extra_runs), 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT wt.match_id || '-' || wt.over_id || '-' || wt.ball_id), 2) AS bowling_average
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN player p ON b.bowler = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
LEFT JOIN extra_runs ex ON b.match_id = ex.match_id AND b.over_id = ex.over_id AND b.ball_id = ex.ball_id AND b.innings_no = ex.innings_no
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON b.match_id = wt.match_id AND b.over_id = wt.over_id AND b.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND b.innings_no = wt.innings_no
GROUP BY b.bowler, p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT wt.match_id || '-' || wt.over_id || '-' || wt.ball_id) > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 1

    b.bowler AS bowler_id,
    p.player_name AS bowler_name,
    ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(ex.extra_runs), 0)) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT wt.match_id || '-' || wt.over_id || '-' || wt.ball_id), 2) AS bowling_average
FROM ball_by_ball b
JOIN player p ON b.bowler = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
LEFT JOIN extra_runs ex ON b.match_id = ex.match_id AND b.over_id = ex.over_id AND b.ball_id = ex.ball_id AND b.innings_no = ex.innings_no
LEFT JOIN wicket_taken wt ON b.match_id = wt.match_id AND b.over_id = wt.over_id AND b.ball_id = wt.ball_id AND b.innings_no = wt.innings_no
GROUP BY b.bowler, p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT wt.match_id || '-' || wt.over_id || '-' || wt.ball_id) > 0
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
